details.question: 全站累计销售额是多少？
details.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')

details.question: 客单价是多少？

details.question: 各城市的销售额是多少？按销售额从高到低排序
details.sql:
SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
